facts: ESPN, Sept 29-30: offensive and defensive players both have the right to stay on a direct path to the basket; both can be called for a foul if they go out of their way to bump the other off that path. Part of four points of emphasis with push-offs, screens and off-ball contact.
hook: The NBA just said you're allowed to bump a player, but only if he's doing one thing.
lane: Rule lane (strongest lane in the data)
name: The new 'straight-line pathway' rule
pinned: Straight-line rule: fair to the defender or just a new way to get a foul called?
